name: arity-of-a-function-held-as-a-value
description: A function's length counts each parameter before the first one with a default or a rest, and code holding the function may read it, so in a JavaScript package an unread parameter the length counts is reported at probable in a function passed as a value, an unread parameter after a default keeps its class, a function whose length the program reads through its own name reports no parameter, and a function only called by name reports its unread parameter at certain.
